real_defects.issue: Transaction-block tracking diverged from PostgreSQL in sql.mjs and engine.mjs: ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT closed the block (a CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY that PostgreSQL refuses read clean, and NOT VALID + VALIDATE in one block went unflagged), ABORT was not recognised (false create-index-concurrently-in-tx), BEGIN nested by depth (BEGIN; BEGIN; COMMIT left a block open), and COMMIT AND CHAIN closed the block. Fixed with a shared transactionEffect() and 5 failing-first engine tests plus 2 sql tests.
